structuredContent.name: parties.reactivate-party
structuredContent.description: Reactivate an existing inactive party. Processing must be unrestricted and the current erasure status must be Active. An already active party is unchanged only after these checks.

PartyId.description: The supplied PartyId of the party to reactivate, at most 128 characters; tenant comes from the gateway envelope. Use ASCII letters or digits plus '.', '_' or '-'; start and end with an ASCII letter or digit. McpCli refuses legacy braced, parenthesized and X-format GUID PartyId values before Gateway submission, although Parties accepts them.
